name: duopore-public-missing-record-field-audit
description: Find missing details before you import a list, so you know which rows to fix.

interface.longDescription: Find missing details before you import a list, so you know which rows to fix. Paste your rows and choose the fields each row needs: name, reference or category. Get a clear list of blanks and missing fields. Optional fields can stay empty. The app checks what you share; it does not guess missing values or fill them in.
defaultPrompt: Find rows missing a name, reference or category.
Check which required fields are blank before I import this list.

positive.prompt: Use Missing Record Field Audit with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"records":[{"recordId":"001","name":"Alpha","reference":" "},{"recordId":"002","name":"Beta","reference":"002","category":"Retail"}],"requiredFields":["name","reference","category"]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 missing field values across 1 records.","rows":[{"recordId":"001","field":"reference","status":"blank"},{"recordId":"001","field":"category","status":"absent"}],"warnings":["No values are inferred; text presence does not validate meaning."]}
